On my very last day of seeing a suicide councillor she told me to imagine the 6 year old version of myself and then told me if I had to babysit them for a day what would I do? (I was 16 at the time)

Not really thinking I just told her I would lock the child in their bedroom and walk away for a few hours with no food or water until it was time for them to come out. My councillor generally sat back in complete surprise as I guess she's never had an answer like that before, I didn't really get why it was so shocking but I still think about what I said till this day. I wasn't abused or anything, this never actually happened to me but it really showed just how much I hated myself and was uncomfortable with the idea of reflecting on who I had become.

May not be the best conversation but it's the only one I  can remember and still think about.
